draft.title: Centuries and millennia
card: A century is a block of 100 years.
A millennium is a block of 1,000 years. It holds ten centuries.
Centuries are counted from the year 1, so the 1st century CE runs from 1 to 100 CE. The 2nd century CE runs from 101 to 200 CE.
BCE centuries count back in time. The 5th century BCE runs from 500 to 401 BCE, and the 4th century BCE runs from 400 to 301 BCE.
draft.remember: Count centuries in blocks of 100 years, starting from the year 1, so the 1st century ends at the year 100.

a.q: Which years make up the 3rd century CE?
a.why: The 1st century CE is 1 to 100 and the 2nd is 101 to 200, so the 3rd is 201 to 300 CE. The option 200 to 299 is tempting, but centuries start at the year 1, not at 0.
a.clue: The 1st century CE ends at the year 100.

b.q: A stone tablet from Mesopotamia is dated to 380 BCE. Which century does it belong to?
b.why: The 4th century BCE runs from 400 to 301 BCE, and 380 BCE falls inside it. The 3rd century BCE is tempting because the year starts with 3, but it runs from 300 to 201 BCE.
b.clue: Find the block of 100 years that contains 380, counting back in time.

check.summary: No problems found. Both answers are correct: the 3rd century CE is 201 to 300 CE, and 380 BCE falls in the 4th century BCE (400 to 301 BCE).
